answers.question: Tell me about a time you had to keep track of many items or tasks at once.
answers.tip: Think of a time you tracked many things at once, such as supplies, people, or deadlines.
answers.situation: In my role as a Unit Supply Specialist in the U.S. Army, I was responsible for the equipment and supplies a whole unit depended on.
answers.task: I needed to make sure everything was counted, stored, and available when people needed it.
answers.action: I kept organized records, checked them regularly against what was on the shelves, and fixed any differences I found.
answers.result: [Add what changed because of your work, such as fewer missing items or faster issue times.]

answers.question: Tell me about a time you taught or coached someone.
answers.tip: Think of any time you taught someone a task, even informally, such as showing a new teammate how things work.
answers.situation: As a Warehouse Supervisor at Acme Logistics, I worked with team members who had different levels of experience.
answers.task: I needed to get newer team members working safely and correctly.
answers.action: I showed them the process step by step, watched them do it, and gave feedback until they were comfortable.
answers.result: [Add how the person improved or what the team gained from the training.]

answers.question: Describe a time something went wrong and you had to fix it quickly.
